import statistics

# Total Federal securities outstanding (in millions) for each month
# Fiscal year is July of prior year through June of stated year

# FY 1990: July 1989 - June 1990
fy1990 = [
    2824487, 2860454, 2881112, 2924765, 2946111, 2975537,
    2996900, 3025827, 3081893, 3093076, 3127229, 3175461
]

# FY 1991: July 1990 - June 1991
fy1991 = [
    3200338, 3243281, 3266073, 3307748, 3363205, 3397325,
    3443129, 3488624, 3491694, 3470530, 3522261, 3562942
]

# FY 1992: July 1991 - June 1992
fy1992 = [
    3597294, 3636298, 3683054, 3735584, 3766152, 3820403,
    3826612, 3844741, 3897204, 3907963, 3950469, 4000678
]

# FY 1993: July 1992 - June 1993
fy1993 = [
    4025949, 4064327, 4082871, 4085732, 4151504, 4195926,
    4185886, 4216166, 4250287, 4274361, 4316774, 4372677
]

# Calculate sums for each fiscal year
sum_1990 = sum(fy1990)
sum_1991 = sum(fy1991)
sum_1992 = sum(fy1992)
sum_1993 = sum(fy1993)

print(f"FY 1990 sum: {sum_1990}")
print(f"FY 1991 sum: {sum_1991}")
print(f"FY 1992 sum: {sum_1992}")
print(f"FY 1993 sum: {sum_1993}")

# Now fit linear regression
# x = fiscal year (1990, 1991, 1992, 1993)
# y = sum of monthly totals

x = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]
y = [sum_1990, sum_1991, sum_1992, sum_1993]

# Calculate means
n = len(x)
mean_x = sum(x) / n
mean_y = sum(y) / n

# Calculate slope and intercept
numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

print(f"\nLinear Regression:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Project for FY 1995
x_1995 = 1995
y_pred_1995 = slope * x_1995 + intercept
print(f"\nProjected sum for FY 1995: {y_pred_1995}")

# Average (divide by 12)
avg_1995 = y_pred_1995 / 12
print(f"Projected average for FY 1995: {avg_1995}")

# Round to nearest whole number
result = round(avg_1995)
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded): {result}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Fiscal year sums (in millions)
fy_sums = {
    1990: 35912852,
    1991: 40757150,
    1992: 45666452,
    1993: 50222460
}

# Linear regression: y = mx + b
x = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]
y = [fy_sums[1990], fy_sums[1991], fy_sums[1992], fy_sums[1993]]

n = len(x)
mean_x = sum(x) / n
mean_y = sum(y) / n

# Calculate slope (m) and intercept (b)
numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
m = numerator / denominator
b = mean_y - m * mean_x

print(f"Linear Regression: y = {m:.4f}x + {b:.4f}")
print(f"  Slope (m): {m:,.2f}")
print(f"  Intercept (b): {b:,.2f}")

# Project for fiscal year 1995
x_1995 = 1995
y_pred = m * x_1995 + b
print(f"\nProjected sum for FY 1995: {y_pred:,.2f} million")

# Calculate average (divide by 12)
avg = y_pred / 12
print(f"Projected average (sum/12): {avg:,.2f} million")

# Round to nearest whole number
result = round(avg)
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded): {result}")

# Show the data points and regression line for verification
print("\n--- Verification ---")
for year in [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]:
    pred = m * year + b
    actual = fy_sums[year]
    print(f"FY {year}: Actual={actual:,}, Predicted={pred:,.0f}, Diff={actual-pred:,.0f}")
EOF
